resources.string: These apply the next time you press Start launcher.
These apply at once, in the game too.

The official PD2 launcher and the game it starts use this screen size. Fewer lines are smoother; the picture is scaled up to fill the screen. The game\'s own graphics options are in the game (Ctrl+O).
The display\'s full size on Adreno GPUs, 720 lines on Mali GPUs. The launcher\'s window needs the room.
D2GL\'s settings for the game\'s look, written at the next start. What you change in the game (Ctrl+O) stays until you pick another profile.
Performance on Mali GPUs and on Adreno GPUs up to the 650, Default on newer Adrenos.
D2GL\'s advanced settings tuned down for older devices: a simpler shader, no sharpening, no bloom.
This screen shows up to %1$d frames a second. At 60 the game uses less battery and stays cooler, but moves less smoothly.
The official PD2 launcher\'s Options set the renderer (Glide or DirectDraw), Skip to Battle.net and the game\'s sound in the background.
Keep the screen on during play
The screen does not dim or turn off while the game shows.
A small counter at the top of the game: the frames the game draws each second.
On. Android may pause the game and the launcher\'s updates while the screen is off. Choose \"Not optimised\" for PD2 Launcher Lite in the list that opens.
Off for PD2 Launcher Lite. The game goes on in the background.
Off. Android may stop the game while PD2 Launcher Lite is in the background.
On. The session notification keeps the official launcher and the game running.
